kebab_example: aliyun mts register-custom-face --category-id CategoryId001-0000 --person-id PersonId001-0000 --image-url http://example-0000.jpeg --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterCustomFace

parameters.help_en:
The figure library ID, which uniquely identifies a custom figure library. This ID is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness. Save this ID properly for use when calling other operations.
<notice>This ID cannot be the same as a system figure library ID. If they are the same, the system figure library is used by default. The maximum length is 120 characters. Both Chinese and English characters are supported. The ID is case-insensitive.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物库ID，⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物库。由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性（请妥善保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用）。
<notice>不能与系统⼈物库ID相同，如果相同则默认使用系统人物库。最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。></notice>
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The figure ID, which uniquely identifies a custom figure. This ID is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness. Save this ID properly for use when calling other operations.
The maximum length is 120 characters. Both Chinese and English characters are supported. The ID is case-insensitive. The returned FaceId is of the String type
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物ID，⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物。由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性（请妥善保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用） 。
最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写，返回FaceId为String类型
parameters.name: person_id

parameters.help_en: The public URL of the face image to be registered. The image must contain one and only one frontal face
parameters.help_zh: 需要注册的⼈脸图⽚公网地址，图⽚中有且仅包含⼀张正脸
parameters.name: image_url
